newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Mobile Comms Vodafone revenue up 70 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mobile Comms Vodafone revenue up 70 pct.

text.p: Mobile Communications Holdings Ltd said on Friday that Vodafone Australia had posted a 70-percent increase in revenue to A$230 million for the year to March 31.
The loss for the year was A$18.94 million, down from a loss of A$44.22 million in the previous corresponding period.
Mobile Communications owns five percent of Vodafone Australia.
Vodafone said it had increased capital expenditure on its Australian network to A$347 million during the 1996/97 year.

"Vodafone remains very committed to Australia, with our total investment likely to exceed $1 billion during the current financial year," said chief executive of Vodafone Australasia Pty Ltd John Peett.
Vodafone said that as of July 1997 its network had 325,000 mobile digital subscribers.
Mobile Communications shares closed untraded but bid 10 cents lower at A$2.50.
